title: EnzymeMiner 2.0: advancing automated enzyme discovery with expansive sequence mining and smart property analysis.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Read the open-access full text via paper_context. The data availability statement lists only the web server; no repository accession, Zenodo/Dryad record or downloadable table was found. A HEAD request to the server returned an HTML page (HTTP 200, 54 KB). The Europe PMC supplementary-file listing timed out after 75 s and was not retried.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That the per-sequence annotations (melting temperature from TmProt, optimal pH from OphPred, aggregation propensity from AggreProt, plus catalytic activity and efficiency) are computed by prediction tools, not measured.

a1_downloadable.note: Paper only: the 'data' is a web server that runs user-submitted mining jobs. No fixed dataset is deposited, and the supplement could not be retrieved.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Paper only: no measured outcome column. The property columns in job outputs are tool predictions, and a target would have to be built from outside sources.

a3_inputs_present.note: Paper only: job outputs presumably include sequences. Not checked.

a4_units_stated.note: No table was opened, so units could not be checked.

a5_enough_rows.note: There is no fixed dataset to count rows in.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No downloadable counts to compare with the paper.

a8_label_provenance.note: Paper text: the Tm (melting temperature), pH optimum, activity and aggregation labels are outputs of other machine-learning models (TmProt, OphPred, AggreProt and others). Training on them would only copy those models.

backbone.name: ESM-2 (protein language model) would fit, but there is no measured label to train on

honest_claim_h3: A model trained on EnzymeMiner annotations would only claim to reproduce the predictions of TmProt, OphPred and AggreProt. It would not predict any measured enzyme property.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use enzyme sequences found by database mining to predict melting temperature, best pH and aggregation tendency.
plain_idea.train_on: Protein sequences returned by an EnzymeMiner search job; the number of sequences is unknown because no fixed dataset is deposited.
plain_idea.predict: Stability, pH optimum and aggregation scores. In this resource these come from other prediction tools, not from lab measurements.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Enzyme engineers could rank candidate enzymes before testing them in the lab. But labels made by other models teach nothing new.

label_elsewhere.sources: Not assessed; rejected at Part A.
label_elsewhere.why: Rejected at Part A, so this was not explored.

ml_idea: None viable from this resource. Measured melting-temperature data such as the Meltome Atlas would have to replace these labels, which turns it into a different project.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; there is no dataset.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Already killed: the data availability statement lists only a web server, and the property labels are predictions.

verdict_reason: This is a web-server tool paper with no deposited dataset (fails A1). Its property annotations are other models' predictions, not measurements (fails A8).
